draft.title: How the Mongols conquered
card: Mongol armies were made up mostly of horse archers. Mongol children learned to ride and shoot from a young age, so the soldiers could fire arrows accurately while riding fast.
Mongol armies moved quickly and used clever tactics. One trick was to pretend to retreat, which drew the enemy out of a strong position so the Mongols could turn and attack.
The Mongols also used terror. Cities that gave in were often spared, but cities that fought could be destroyed. Word of this spread, and some enemies surrendered without a fight.
Mongol armies took in skilled people from the lands they conquered, such as engineers. These engineers knew how to build and use siege machines, which helped the Mongols break into walled cities.
draft.remember: Speed, tactics and terror won battles, and borrowed engineers won walled cities.

a.q: Why were skilled engineers from conquered peoples useful to the Mongol armies?
opts: They knew how to attack walled cities
They taught Mongol children to ride horses
They led the fake retreats in open battle
They spread fear of the Mongols to cities
a.why: Mongol horse archers were strong in open country, but walls stopped them. Engineers knew how to build siege machines, which helped the Mongols break into cities. Fake retreats were a tactic of the Mongol riders, not a job for engineers.
a.clue: Think about what stops horse archers: a wall.

b.q: A Mongol army reaches a walled city. Its leaders send a message that the city will be spared if it surrenders, but destroyed if it fights. Which Mongol method does this show?
opts: Using terror to make enemies give in
Using engineers to build siege machines
Pretending to retreat to draw out the enemy
Using horse archers to fire while riding
b.why: The message uses fear of destruction to push the city to surrender without a fight. That is terror. Siege machines and fake retreats are about fighting, but here the Mongols are trying to avoid a fight.
b.clue: The message is meant to win the city without any battle.

a.best: They knew how to attack walled cities

b.best: Using terror to make enemies give in
